guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_cpu is the top anomaly (+86.3%, z=+6.26) while every other series is within |z|<2, and checkoutservice logs 129 'failed to send order confirmation ... Failed to serialize response!' errors, which is the call to emailservice. Memory in emailservice rose only +10.2% (z=+0.29) and latency changed little, so CPU is the best-supported fault type, though the serialization error could also point to an application-level fault.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate and relieve CPU saturation on emailservice: check for a CPU stressor or runaway process, then restart the emailservice pod or scale out replicas and raise CPU limits if load-driven.
